# Purpose

Award credit for a defensible cantilever idealization, complete free-body diagram, consistent sign convention, correct internal resultants, accurate hollow-section properties, correct use of the flexure formula, and a conclusion bounded by the stated assumptions.

# Scope of the Base Problem

The base model assumes static loading, a straight prismatic arm, a concentrated load through the seat-post centerline, linear-elastic material response, small deformation, plane sections, and concentric inner and outer rectangles. It neglects arm and hardware self-weight unless included in P, connection flexibility, local attachment stresses, weld and bolt failure, stress concentrations, fatigue, impact, dynamics, and applicable seating or machinery safety requirements.

# Supplemental Assessment Structure

- context interpretation and load path: 20%;
- student idealization and assumptions: 20%;
- internal loading and section properties: 30%;
- bending stress and stress sense: 20%;
- engineering assessment and limitations: 10%.
